title: Outline Grammar of the (Khamti) Language
author: J. F. Needham
description: Foundational nineteenth-century grammar and vocabulary of the Tai Khamti language spoken around Sadiya and the Upper Brahmaputra valley. Details tone contours, nominal classifiers, verbal affixes, and root morphemes shared identically with Tai Khamyang.
